description: uninjured person arrives at ED without CRC processing
minimum_packet_or_corrective_action: triage/screening/security flow record plus public redirection language

description: injured patient arrives by private vehicle
minimum_packet_or_corrective_action: life-threat triage and contamination-control decision log

description: family arrives with mixed contamination/injury status
school group arrives directly at hospital
minimum_packet_or_corrective_action: school authority, receiving-area and guardian notification proof

description: long-term-care residents arrive with mobility/medical support needs
minimum_packet_or_corrective_action: staffing, medication, oxygen and mobility support proof
interpreter, translated form and comprehension check required

description: ED queue spills into unsafe exterior/interior area
minimum_packet_or_corrective_action: security/crowd-control queue observation and CAP required

description: person arrives with service animal or pet

minimum_packet_or_corrective_action: behavioral health support and staff safety evidence

description: patient data captured without secure registry handoff
minimum_packet_or_corrective_action: privacy/security remediation and registry correction required

description: public hospital or CRC guidance asserted as local closure
minimum_packet_or_corrective_action: public context cannot close local readiness
